rationale: Both implementations passed all 9 cases and 98 checks. Guion expresses delivery state changes with SQLite transactions and records retry failures as dead letters with categories and attempt details. Guion measured 0.151560 seconds versus Python at 0.767109 seconds on the selected case.
task: Build a small durable notification relay that validates incoming payloads, records their state, retries delivery, and reports failures to an operator.
trial_observation: Seven randomized pairs: Guion 0.151560s, Python 0.767109s; ratio 0.198. Both passed 9/9 cases and 98/98 checks. Candidate/previous Guion ratio 0.981 (95% interval 0.971–1.016).
caveat: This measures a frozen application case with oracle-check time, not deployed end-to-end relay performance. The candidate/previous-build interval crosses parity.
